g.text: TCP it is a "reliable" protocol that runs on top of
order of messages is not how we sent it
TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) is connection-oriented protocol -
client and service must establish a connection before exchanging data.
Each device have their own IP address to be identified on the network.
For web browsing, typing some address:
- DNS lookup will find the server's IP address
- Client sends a SYN packet to server
- Client sends a final ACK to confirm this connection.
After this TCP connection is established.
